import unittest
from rosterkit.notices import absence_notice
from rosterkit.models import Mark, Student
from datetime import date

PUPIL = Student("s1", "Lovelace", "Ada", "A")

class NoticeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_lists_absent_days_in_order(self):
        marks = [
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 5), "absent"),
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 4), "present"),
            Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 3), "absent")
        ]
        text = absence_notice(PUPIL, marks)
        self.assertEqual(text, "Ada Lovelace missed 2 days: 2026-09-03, 2026-09-05")

    def test_single_day(self):
        text = absence_notice(PUPIL, [Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 3), "absent")])
        self.assertIn("missed 1 day:", text)

    def test_other_student(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, [Mark("s2", date(2026, 9, 3), "absent")])

    def test_no_absences(self):
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            absence_notice(PUPIL, [Mark("s1", date(2026, 9, 3), "late")])
